name: TAANN
recent: TAANN 近期主要围绕例行披露：每月生产数据、季度产量披露，以及董事与大股东（DATO SRI WAHAB BIN HAJI DOLAH、DATUK AMAR ABDUL HAMED BIN HAJI SEPAWI、DATO WONG KUO HEA 及 UPAYA RAJANG SDN. BHD.）的持股变动申报。公司同时宣布第二次中期单层股息每股 15 仙，并已公布除息、登记与派发日期。
notable: 宣布第二次中期单层股息每股 15 仙。
发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的季度业绩报告。
发布 2025 年年报及企业治理报告。
risks: 多名董事及大股东（包括 DATO WONG KUO HEA、UPAYA RAJANG SDN. BHD.、DATUK AMAR ABDUL HAMED BIN HAJI SEPAWI、DATO SRI WAHAB BIN HAJI DOLAH）近期申报持股变动。

recent_en: TAANN's recent disclosures are mainly routine: monthly production figures, quarterly production disclosure, and changes in director and substantial shareholder interests (DATO SRI WAHAB BIN HAJI DOLAH, DATUK AMAR ABDUL HAMED BIN HAJI SEPAWI, DATO WONG KUO HEA and UPAYA RAJANG SDN. BHD.). The company also declared a second interim single-tier dividend of 15 sen per share, with ex-date, entitlement and payment dates announced.
notable_en: Declared a second interim single-tier dividend of 15 sen per ordinary share.
Released the quarterly results for the financial period ended 30 June 2026.
Issued the Annual Report and CG Report 2025.
risks_en: Several directors and substantial shareholders (including DATO WONG KUO HEA, UPAYA RAJANG SDN. BHD., DATUK AMAR ABDUL HAMED BIN HAJI SEPAWI and DATO SRI WAHAB BIN HAJI DOLAH) recently reported changes in their interests.
